# Vektörel Yapı Proje Mühendislik

> Structural engineering office in İzmir, Türkiye (Vektörel Yapı Proje Mühendislik İnşaat Sanayi ve Ticaret Ltd. Şti.). Structural design of reinforced concrete and steel structures; our deepest specialisation is water-retaining structures and water and wastewater treatment plants. We work for main contractors and process companies in Türkiye, Libya and Iraq, and correspond in English and Turkish.

- Founder and design engineer: Burak Uçar, M.Sc. Structural Engineering (İstanbul Technical University)
- Codes, depending on project location and specification: TS 500, TBDY 2018, ACI 318, ACI 350, ACI 350.3, BS 8007, ASCE 7, AISC 360
- Contact: info@vektorelyapi.com, +905325839769 (phone and WhatsApp)
- Website languages: Turkish (default), English, Arabic

## Services

- [Services](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/services/): We prepare structural calculations and construction drawings for treatment plants and water-retaining structures, and for concrete and steel structures.
- [Structural Design for Treatment Plants and Water-Retaining Structures](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/services/treatment-plant-structural-design/): Structural design for wastewater and water treatment plants: aeration basins, circular clarifiers, tanks and plant buildings. Reference projects in Türkiye, Libya and Iraq.
- [Structural Design for Reinforced Concrete Structures](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/services/reinforced-concrete-structural-design/): Structural design for reinforced concrete structures: residential, public and industrial buildings, foundations and retaining walls, and seismic assessment and strengthening of existing buildings. TBDY 2018, TS 500, ACI 318.
- [Structural Design for Steel Structures](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/services/steel-structural-design/): Structural design for steel structures: warehouses, workshops, agricultural and industrial buildings. Calculations, connection details and construction drawings.
- [Structural Design in Libya](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/structural-design-libya/): Structural design in Libya: reinforced concrete and steel structures, wastewater treatment plants, water reservoirs and water-retaining structures, plus tender-stage structural quantities. Reference projects in Suluq and Al Bayda.
- [Structural Design in Iraq](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/structural-design-iraq/): Structural design in Iraq: reinforced concrete and steel structures, wastewater treatment plants and water-retaining structures, plus tender-stage structural quantities. Reference projects in Basra and Halabja.

## Projects

- [Novart Space Technologies Workshop (Teknopark Istanbul)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/novart-atolye/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Delivered: September 2026; Client: Novart Uzay Teknolojileri A.Ş.. We prepared the structural design of a steel workshop building at Teknopark Istanbul for Novart Uzay Teknolojileri A.Ş. The structural system consists of steel frames and bracing. The design was delivered in September 2026.
- [Uşak Leather OIZ Wastewater Recovery Plant (Uşak, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/usak-dkosb/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Structures: 2; Delivered: May 2026. We prepared the structural design of 2 structures at the wastewater recovery plant of Uşak Leather Organised Industrial Zone. The design uses ACI, BS and TBDY 2018 codes and was delivered in May 2026.
- [Suluq Wastewater Treatment Plant (Suluq, Libya)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/suluq-aat/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 12,000 m³/day; Structures: 25; Contractor: Set Construction / Timtaş; Delivered: December 2025. We prepared revisions to the existing design of the 12,000 m³/day wastewater treatment plant in Suluq, Libya. The revisions cover all 25 structures on site, including reinforced concrete basins, circular clarifiers, service bridges and other plant structures. The work was carried out for the main contractor, Set Construction / Timtaş, to ACI and BS codes, and delivered in December 2025.
- [Al Bayda WWTP Tender Design (Al Bayda, Libya)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/al-bayda-ihale/): Tender-stage structural documentation by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 25,000 + 75,000 + 100,000 m³/day; Plants: 3; Bidder: Set Construction / Timtaş; Delivered: December 2025. We prepared the structural tender documentation for three wastewater treatment plants tendered in Al Bayda, Libya, with capacities of 25,000, 75,000 and 100,000 m³/day. The work was carried out for the bidder, Set Construction / Timtaş, which won the contract. The documentation was delivered in December 2025.
- [Şişecam Kırklareli Fire Escape Corridor (Şişecam Flat Glass Plant, Kırklareli)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/sisecam-yangin-koridoru/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Contractor: Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş.; Delivered: December 2025. We prepared the structural design of a steel fire escape corridor at Şişecam's flat glass plant in Kırklareli. The work was carried out for the contractor, Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş., and delivered in December 2025.
- [Suluq Clean Water Reservoir and Pump Station (Suluq, Libya)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/suluq-temiz-su-tanki/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 20,000 m³; Contractor: Set Construction / Timtaş; Delivered: November 2025. We prepared the structural design of a 20,000 m³ clean water reservoir and pump station in Suluq, Libya. The design covers the base and walls of the reinforced concrete reservoir and the superstructure of the pump station. The work was carried out for the main contractor, Set Construction / Timtaş, and delivered in November 2025.
- [Yenikapı Biological Wastewater Treatment Plant (Yenikapı, Istanbul)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/yenikapi-baat/): Ongoing project.
- [Basra Wastewater Treatment Plant (Basra, Iraq)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/irak-aat/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 155,000 m³/day; Delivered: November 2025. We prepared the structural design of the 155,000 m³/day wastewater treatment plant in Basra, Iraq. The design covers reinforced concrete basins, channels and circular clarifiers, and was delivered in November 2025.
- [Şişecam Kırklareli LV Kiosk Foundation (Şişecam Flat Glass Plant, Kırklareli)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/sisecam-ag-kosk-temeli/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Contractor: Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş.; Delivered: May 2025. We prepared the structural design of a reinforced concrete foundation for a low-voltage (LV) kiosk at Şişecam's flat glass plant in Kırklareli. The work was carried out for the contractor, Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş., and delivered in May 2025.
- [İSKİ Five-Plant WWTP Tender Design (Bozhane, Kilyos, Koçullu, Reşadiye, Riva — Istanbul)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/iski-5-aat-ihale/): Tender-stage structural documentation by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 52,000 m³/day; Plants: 5; Bidder: Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji ve Mühendislik; Delivered: April 2025. We prepared the structural tender documentation for five wastewater treatment plants in Istanbul (Bozhane, Kilyos, Koçullu, Reşadiye and Riva) with a combined capacity of 52,000 m³/day. The work was carried out for the bidder, Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji ve Mühendislik, which won the contract. The documentation was delivered in April 2025.
- [Kütahya OIZ Wastewater Treatment Plant (Kütahya, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/kutahya-osb-aat/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 15,000 m³/day; Structures: 9; Delivered: March 2025. We prepared the structural design for the civil works of 9 structures at the 15,000 m³/day wastewater treatment plant of Kütahya Organised Industrial Zone. The structures include reinforced concrete basins and a circular clarifier. The design uses ACI, BS and TBDY 2018 codes and was delivered in March 2025.
- [Şişecam Kırklareli Warehouse Façade Columns (Şişecam Flat Glass Plant, Kırklareli)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/sisecam-ambar-cephe/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Contractor: Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş.; Delivered: December 2024. We prepared the structural design of the steel columns for a warehouse façade at Şişecam's flat glass plant in Kırklareli. The columns carry the façade cladding. The work was carried out for the contractor, Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş., and delivered in December 2024.
- [Uzunburun Solid Waste Facility Aeration Basin (Manisa, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/manisa-uzunburun/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 500 m³/day; Structures: 1; Delivered: November 2024; Client: Manisa Büyükşehir Belediyesi. We prepared the structural design of a 500 m³/day reinforced concrete aeration basin at the Uzunburun Solid Waste Facility of Manisa Metropolitan Municipality. The design uses ACI, BS and TBDY 2018 codes and was delivered in November 2024.
- [Balıkesir OIZ WWTP Additional Structures (Balıkesir, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/balikesir-osb-aat/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 10,000 m³/day; Structures: 5; Delivered: June 2024. We prepared the structural design of 5 structures added to the 10,000 m³/day wastewater treatment plant of Balıkesir Organised Industrial Zone. They include a DAF unit, recovery and distribution structures, and reinforced concrete buildings with steel roofs. The design uses TBDY 2018, TS 500, ÇYTHYE 2018, ACI and BS codes and was delivered in June 2024.
- [Halabja Wastewater Treatment Plant (Halabja, Iraq)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/halepce-aat/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 800 m³/day; Structures: 10; Delivered: May 2024; Client: Halabja Group. We prepared the structural design of 10 structures at the 800 m³/day wastewater treatment plant in Halabja, Iraq, for Halabja Group. The structures include reinforced concrete basins and a circular clarifier. The design follows ACI and BS codes and was delivered in May 2024.
- [Mey İçki Alaşehir Plant Additional Structures (Alaşehir, Manisa, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/mey-icki-alasehir/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Structures: 2; Delivered: July 2023; Client: Mey İçki. We prepared the structural design of 2 additional structures at Mey İçki's Alaşehir plant, one of them a circular final clarifier. The design uses TBDY 2018, TS 500, ÇYTHYE 2018, ACI and BS codes and was delivered in July 2023.
- [Aliağa Şakran Residential Building (Şakran, Aliağa, İzmir, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/aliaga-sakran-konut/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Delivered: July 2023. We prepared the structural design of a 990 m² reinforced concrete residential building in Şakran, Aliağa, with a basement, ground floor and 3 upper storeys. The structural system consists of high-ductility frames and solid shear walls. The design was delivered in July 2023.
- [Aliağa Furniture Warehouse (Aliağa, İzmir, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/aliaga-mobilya-deposu/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Delivered: April 2023. We prepared the structural design of a 36 × 30 m, 1,080 m² steel furniture warehouse in Aliağa. The design was delivered in April 2023.
- [Şişecam Çatalca Crane Foundation (Çatalca, İstanbul, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/sisecam-catalca-vinc-temeli/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Contractor: Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş.; Delivered: March 2023. We prepared the structural design of a reinforced concrete crane foundation at Şişecam's site in Çatalca, Istanbul. The work was carried out for the contractor, Alkataş İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş., and delivered in March 2023.
- [Hacı Ömerli Recreation Area Amenity Building (Aliağa, İzmir, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/haci-omerli-mesire/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Delivered: January 2023. We prepared the structural design of a 240 m² steel amenity building at the Hacı Ömerli Recreation Area in Aliağa. The building uses 18.8 t of structural steel. The design was delivered in January 2023.
- [Anadolu Efes Çumra Plant Additional Structures (Çumra, Konya, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/anadolu-efes-cumra/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 1,200 m³/day; Structures: 4; Delivered: November 2022; Client: Anadolu Efes. We prepared the structural design of 4 additional structures (1,200 m³/day) at Anadolu Efes' Çumra plant. They include a filtration structure and a steel filtration building, a PAC storage structure and a steel storage building. The design uses TBDY 2018, TS 500, ÇYTHYE 2018, ACI and BS codes and was delivered in November 2022.
- [Gönenli Dairy Akhisar Wastewater Treatment Plant (Akhisar, Manisa, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/gonenli-akhisar-aat/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Capacity: 3,500 m³/day; Structures: 9; Delivered: September 2022; Client: Gönenli Süt ve Süt Ürünleri A.Ş.. We prepared the structural design of 8 structures at the 3,500 m³/day wastewater treatment plant of Gönenli Süt ve Süt Ürünleri A.Ş. in Akhisar. They include equalisation and aeration basins and a circular final clarifier. The design uses ACI, BS and TBDY 2018 codes and was delivered in September 2022.
- [K-1 Plaza Additional Storey and Strengthening ()](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/k1-plaza-ilave-kat/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Delivered: September 2022. We prepared the design for an additional storey, the strengthening of the existing reinforced concrete building and the construction drawings at K-1 Plaza. The work covers 300 m² of enclosed area and was delivered in September 2022.
- [Aliağa Farm Barn (Aliağa, İzmir, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/aliaga-ciftlik-ahir/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Delivered: December 2021. We prepared the structural design of a 30 × 90 m, 2,700 m² steel barn for a farm project in Aliağa. We also designed the farm's office building as part of the same project. The design was delivered in December 2021.
- [Aliağa Farm Office Building (Aliağa, İzmir, Türkiye)](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/projects/aliaga-ciftlik-idari-bina/): Structural engineering by Vektörel Yapı; Delivered: December 2021. We prepared the structural design of a 30 × 15 m, two-storey, 900 m² steel office building for a farm project in Aliağa. We also designed the farm's barn as part of the same project. The design was delivered in December 2021.

## Technical Notes

- [Hydrodynamic Effects in Water-Retaining Structures](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/technical-notes/su-tutan-yapilarda-hidrodinamik-etkiler/): A general look at the additional forces the contained water transfers to a tank during an earthquake.
- [How the Turkish Seismic Code (TBDY 2018) Shapes a Structural Design](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/technical-notes/tbdy-2018-statik-projeye-nasil-yansir/): A general look at the design decisions influenced by the Turkish Building Earthquake Code.
- [Structural System Options for Steel Warehouses and Workshops](https://www.vektorelyapi.com/en/technical-notes/celik-depo-ve-atolye-yapilarinda-tasiyici-sistem/): A general look at what determines the structural system of single-storey steel buildings such as warehouses and workshops.
